reviews.title: No longer what it was
reviews.text: I used to like this app because it was multifunctional at the free level. They have removed the remote feature and the option to mirror. No longer a favorite and looking for a new app.

reviews.title: Worked great until they updated the app
reviews.text: This worked great until they updated the app. Now it shuts down constantly and is a real disappointment

reviews.title: Price upfront please
reviews.text: This shows up as a “free app” which means free for any option except those that you need as a basic teleprompter, Same as my word processing app. As soon as you choose any “basic” functionality like mirroring the truth pops up in the form of a subscription page. Here’s a thought,  If your charging for the app, why don’t you just say your charging for the app instead of wasting everybody’s time.

reviews.title: Essential functions paywall
reviews.text: Slick app but to mirror text you need to pay £80. If you are using a traditional teleprompter the free app os useless

reviews.title: Teleprompter Pro
reviews.text: Great app- but the app often has trouble pairing to another device to remote control. Often results in awkward waiting times while on set troubleshooting.

reviews.title: Crashes every time
reviews.text: Every time I try to use my iPhone to control my iPad it crashes. It doesn’t matter which is the host or which is the remote. It used to work about 3 years ago. I need to cancel and find something reliable

reviews.title: Piece of junk
reviews.text: Save your money. The glitchiest teleprompter app I’ve ever used and that’s saying something. Crashes half the time you try to connect a remote, and the other half it connects but the scroll is jumpy. Only after multiple attempts and the most delicate of troubleshooting can you make it work once. Using it the next day in a different location? Totally different rules. Upgrading to pro is totally useless. Works fine if you don’t need to connect a remote, but that’s kind of the whole point of upgrading to “Pro”.

reviews.title: No deja guardar. Solo cuando quiere.
reviews.text:
Por qué no me deja guardar después de grabar?

Es una estafa. Ni vídeo cortos ni largos, después de pagar 70 euros, no me vale para nada!

reviews.title: Schlecht zu bedienen
reviews.text: Das Recording läuft dauerhaft, oder gar nicht. Mal ist der Timer da, mal nicht, die Buttons sind so klein und damit kaum zu drücken. Hab aufgegeben. Es nervt.

reviews.title: Too buggy
reviews.text: So buggy. Words jumping doing the scrolling like they having a seizure or something. Then the output of the video is doing the same thing. Glitchy. I restarted my phone. Made sure I have plenty of space nothing is working

reviews.title: Not synchronizing scripts to all devices
reviews.text: I recommended this product to many of my Actor friends. The last month it’s been very painful because the Scripts don’t see the synchronize.

reviews.title: Pas très convainquant
reviews.text: Une utilisation pas très instinctive mais on vous encourage à prendre la version premium. Dommage car j’étais prêt à prendre la version payante si l’essai avait été concluant ! Pas très honnête cette démarche !

reviews.title: Synchronisatieprobleem
reviews.text:
Ik gebruik Teleprompter bij het opnemen van voiceovers. Werkte tot 1,5 week geleden als een zonnetje. Nu heb ik echter synchronisatieproblemen. Van ipad > macbook werkt. Van iphone > macbook werkt. Van macbook > iphone werkt niet. Van macbook > ipad werkt niet. Van iphone > ipad werkt niet. Van ipad > iphone werkt niet.

Overal staat cloud-sync aan. 

Heb app verwijderd van iphone en opnieuw geïnstalleerd: helemaal geen scripts meer.

reviews.title: Bella ma
reviews.text: A volte va a volte no. A volte sincronizza a volte no . A volte il remoto va a volte no e rimango spiazzato davanti al cliente

reviews.title: The developer is gaslighting over feature removal
reviews.text: This product use to be great. Functionality such as mirroring mode when put under a beam splitting glass has been shifted over to a paid feature. Between THIS app and the near identical Teleprompter app by the same developer the support isn’t great and features are slowly being eroded. Please avoid.

reviews.title: Bad app
reviews.text: Horrible app cannot utilize the record button when vertical utilize an iPad

reviews.title: Con app!
reviews.text: I payed for features that are now behind a subscription model. I demand either a refund or access to features like mirroring that I previously payed for that I’m now expected to pay over 50 pounds a year for. The support/help function in the app does not work. I can see another review on here saying the same thing and the developers denying it.

reviews.title: Mirroring removed from paid app
reviews.text: I paid for this app a few years ago to access the mirroring function. This has been removed now and I’m  to pay £60 a year for this basic functionality. What a rip off, and I’m pretty sure this breaks the TOS too.

reviews.title: Locked basic functions behind paywall
reviews.text: When you could use this app, they locked the mirror text behind a paywall in 2026 - to answer note from developer - how was I using it then? I’d use it if you still had the weekly option.

reviews.title: It is obvious you are reading from a paper
reviews.text: It is not helpful. Anyone could see you are reading from a paper overlay
